text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. While there was tree-cover loss within the asset that year, it affected only about 81.3 hectares—roughly 2.23% of the total 3,643.5-hectare property. The loss occurred in patches, primarily within a planted forest area (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with some smaller patches (37.3 ha) below the 0.5-hectare detection threshold. The remaining 97.8% of the property retained tree cover in 2021.
